name: Chakli
subtitle: spiralled savoury crisps from a multi-grain flour, the centre of the Diwali faral

ingredients.qty: 3 tbsp hot, for the dough, plus 500ml for frying
ingredients.note: the hot oil rubbed into the flour is what makes it crumble

prepNotes: Bhajani, the roasted multigrain flour, is what a Maharashtrian household uses. This is a workable version from separate flours.
The hot oil moyan is not optional. Without it the chakli is hard rather than short.

steps.text: Mix the flours with the sesame, cumin, ajwain, chilli powder, asafoetida and salt.
Pour the hot oil over and rub it in until the mixture holds shape when pressed.
steps.tip: It should clump in your fist and break cleanly.

steps.text: Add warm water gradually to a smooth, firm dough. Cover and rest 15 minutes.
Press spirals onto a greased sheet with a chakli press.
Fry on medium until the bubbling stops and they turn even gold, about 5 minutes.
steps.tip: Medium, and do not crowd the pan. Rushed chaklis are raw inside.

steps.text: Drain and cool completely before storing.

storage: Keeps 3 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature.
